name: Fang Over Fang resets Reave when Bloodfang Bite is cast (#578)
contract: Fang Over Fang 504116's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Fang Over Fang 504117, a single SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN with MiscValue 800490 = Reave and MiscValueB 1. Spell.dbc gives 504116 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the aura was inert. The tooltip is 'Casting Bloodfang Bite now has a $h% chance to reset the cooldown of Reave' and the record's own ProcChance is 20, which this scenario does not change. Reave's cooldown is purely a category cooldown (every rank has RecoveryTime 0, Category 752, CategoryRecoveryTime 15000), and 504117's MiscValueB 1 makes Spell::EffectAscensionResetCooldown clear that category as well, so the owned rank 802469 comes off cooldown too. Bloodfang Bite is cast as rank 572551 and needs a Cursed Form for its CasterAuraSpell 525031, which Eternal Curse supplies through the module's marker sync. KNOWN STATISTICAL LIMIT: Reave's cooldown is 15 s and Bloodfang Bite costs a 1.5 s global cooldown, so at most nine casts fit inside one cooldown window. At 20% per cast the chance that a correctly fixed build still fails this assertion is 0.8^9, about 13%. That is above the 0.1% bar this repository's scenarios aim for, and no arrangement of the harness's actions raises the event count inside a 15 s window. Treat a single failure as inconclusive and re-run; a build without the fix fails every time.
